description: Your Zotero library was accidentally synchronized from two different sources, creating duplicate entries for every paper. The library currently contains 20 items but only 10 unique papers — each paper appears exactly twice. To make the situation worse, notes were added to some copies but not others: each paper has one copy with a reading note attached and one bare copy. Your task is to find all duplicate items and merge each pair, ensuring that reading notes from all copies are preserved in the merged result. After completing the merge, every paper should appear exactly once, and any paper that had a note on either copy must still have that note on the surviving entry.
